featured_reviews.name: Deepika Pote
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when your mind feels trapped in an endless loop of thoughts… when problems don’t just stay outside, they follow you everywhere. That’s exactly where we were... when we decided to try the Kohinoor room at Mystery Room, Andheri West..
and honestly, we didn’t realize then how much we needed it.
From the moment we entered, the energy shifted. The staff welcomed us with such warmth..always smiling, patient, and genuinely excited for us. It didn’t feel like just another activity; it felt like someone quietly telling us, “You’re going to feel better here.”
And then the game began.
What I loved the most was how brilliantly the clues were designed...hilarious, clever, and surprisingly nostalgic.. It was a reminder ...It felt like everything I had ever studied, observed, or casually learned in life was suddenly coming together. Each puzzle wasn’t just a task...it was a spark. A distraction. A reminder that the mind can still play, think, and solve… even when it feels heavy.
There were moments we laughed uncontrollably...cant tell you d exact details , moments we got stuck, and moments where we just looked at each other and said, “Wait… could it be this?” And when things started clicking, it wasn’t just about solving the room...it felt like breaking through something inside us. We dint panic ,got angry, or blamed each other but were focused on problem solving..
And then… that bell rang.
That sound ..it wasn’t just a signal that we had completed the task in hand... It was a jolt.... The exact jolt we didn’t know we needed... For those few minutes, we weren’t thinking about stress, worries, or anything weighing us down. We were just present, quick..and connected... We dint think ... We just did what needed to be done ..and laughed out our hearts....
We walked out lighter. Clearer. Almost reset.
If you’re feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or just mentally exhausted, this place is more than just an escape room. It’s a pause. A shift. A small but powerful break from the chaos inside your head.
For me and my sister, it wasn’t just an experience...it was a moment of healing.
A must-visit. Truly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had.

featured_reviews.name: durga janagan
featured_reviews.review_text:
My expectations for this trip were honestly quite low, but Adventure Geek completely exceeded them. The entire experience was well organized, enjoyable, and filled with wonderful memories.
One of my biggest concerns before the trip was the washroom facilities, as this was my first adventure trip. However, I was pleasantly surprised to find that the washrooms were very clean, neat, and well maintained throughout the trip.
A special shoutout to Sohil and Vinay, who led our Mumbai bus group. They guided us exceptionally well, were friendly and approachable, and made the entire journey fun and comfortable. Their experience in managing groups was evident, and they ensured that everyone felt included and had a great time.
The games and activities they conducted were incredibly fun and interactive. They helped everyone connect, break the ice, and create amazing friendships. In just a short time, a group of strangers turned into a group of friends, and that's something I'll always cherish.
What started as a trip with low expectations turned into one of the most memorable experiences I've had. Thank you, Adventure Geek, for the amazing organization, wonderful memories, and the incredible people we met along the way. We absolutely loved Adventure Geek and can't wait to join another trip soon! ❤️🏕️✨🌿

featured_reviews.name: Prachi Biyani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to Bhandardara for the fireflies festival not knowing what to expect. I came back with one of the best weekends of my life.

The trip was special not just because of the destination, but because of the people, the group, the conversations, the memories made along the way. That kind of experience doesn't happen by accident.

Our team leaders Sohil sir, Vinay sir, and Ahbas sir made sure no one felt left out, ever. From ice-breaking games on the bus to bonfire stories under the stars, there was never a dull moment. They ran a seamless two days- smooth, organised, and genuinely fun.

The campsite was well-maintained and hygienic, with easy access to washrooms and a restaurant. One tent for two people, comfort was clearly a priority.

The night trek to the fireflies was the highlight for most, and for good reason. Sohil sir made sure everyone reached the peak safely, and when we got there, it felt like a movie. Watching the fireflies glow across the valley, holding one in your hand... that's a once-in-a-lifetime moment. We even got to click pictures with them, thanks to a local who helped us out.

Food was homelike and hearty- roti sabzi and rice for dinner, poha and bread butter for breakfast, and a lunch stop at Shiv Sagar on the road.

But honestly? The return journey might have been the highlight. We played Mafia on the bus back to Mumbai, full bus participation, absolute chaos, core memory unlocked. We also made a reel. Obviously.

If you're looking for a trip that's well-organised AND actually fun, Adventure Geek delivers. Special mention to Vinay sir and Sohil sir, you made this one unforgettable.

highly recommend. 10/10

featured_reviews.name: Parag Desai
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a lovely experience with Adventure Geek to Bhandardhara Camp. Their hospitality & warmth was exceptional. Their inclusive approach was remarkable. Highly recommend to plan your adventure trips with them.

featured_reviews.name: yashika gothwal
featured_reviews.review_text: Thanks to Adventure Geek to make my first fireflies experience beautiful. We went to their Bhandardara camping for this. Stay, food, travel everything was organised. All the team captains were friendly, fun and highly engaging. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Madhulika Chowdhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
We booked the Bhandardhara Lakeside Camping and Firefly event with Adventure Geek, and it turned out to be one of the most beautiful experiences.

Right from registration to payment, everything was smooth and hassle-free. Unlike some other organizers who make the process feel complicated and ask endless questions, the entire experience here was simple and welcoming.

A special mention to Vinay and Sohil — their positive attitude and friendly nature make you feel like you are travelling with family. They make sure that no one feels left out and everyone feels comfortable throughout the trip.

The itinerary was very well planned with timely pickup, a super social environment, and most importantly, a heavenly camping location. The arrangements were excellent — clean toilets, delicious food, clean bedsheets, pillows and blankets inside the tents, and even a proper backup shelter in case of rain.

They took care of every little thing, from fun games to making sure everyone was enjoying. Unlike some trips that mostly focus only on young crowds, this one felt truly family-friendly where people of all age groups could enjoy equally.

The firefly experience was absolutely magical. I really appreciated how they explained everything beforehand — how to observe this beautiful natural phenomenon without disturbing or harming the fireflies, while staying in sync with nature.

Overall, everything was amazing. A big thanks to Vinay and Sohil for putting so much effort into creating such a wonderful experience. Also, our group members played a huge role in making the trip memorable because everyone was so caring and friendly. We were lucky in that aspect too!

We are definitely looking forward to joining more monsoon trips with Adventure Geek.

— Madhulika & Chetan

featured_reviews.review_text:
We celebrated our son’s birthday at Skycity Mall Play and Learn, and overall, it was a really good experience. The staff was professional, the place is spacious (especially considering Mumbai standards), and everything was clean and well-maintained. Special thanks to Zainab for organizing the party so well , her support made the event smooth and enjoyable.

That said, there are a few areas where the experience can be improved:
1.	Seating Arrangements:
Proper seating inside the party hall would make the event more comfortable for parents and guests.
2.	Gift Management:
A designated cage trolley or secure storage for gifts would help, as the gifts took up a lot of space and needed better handling.
3.	Party Area Access Control:
Even though the party area was separate, non-invitee kids occasionally walked in and started eating food. Better monitoring or access control would ensure the arrangements are used only by invited guests.
4.	Host Involvement:
The party host could spend more time actively overseeing the flow of the event helping with coordination, ensuring things run smoothly, and paying attention to guest needs.
5.	Food Quality:
The food presentation was good, but the taste was average. With the premium pricing, slightly better quality would be appreciated.

I’m sharing this feedback because the charges are on the higher side, so a bit more discipline and attention to detail would
elevate the experience further.

On the positive side, the place is absolutely fun for kids , so much so that they were tired enough to almost skip school the next day! Overall, we had a memorable celebration and hope to see these improvements implemented.

featured_reviews.review_text:
This was our first couple spa experience, and unfortunately, it turned out to be extremely disappointing.

We visited Elite Spa in Borivali after booking a scheduled appointment. As soon as we arrived, the staff immediately started pushing a ₹7,000 membership package in a very hasty manner. We politely informed them that we would first like to experience a session before deciding on any membership.

From the beginning, the hospitality was extremely poor. There was no warm welcome, no proper guidance, and no effort to make first-time customers comfortable. We were simply directed to a room and the door was shut behind us.

The massage experience itself was highly unsatisfactory. The masseuses assigned to us appeared very inexperienced, almost like trainees. We had opted for a Balinese massage, which is supposed to involve moderate and consistent pressure, but the pressure throughout the session was extremely uneven — either too light or unnecessarily harsh.

At one point, I had to pause the session and step out to discuss with my partner whether we should even continue. We then explained our expectations again to the therapists, but even after restarting, the massage remained inconsistent and unprofessional.

The massage strokes were incomplete, coordination between the therapists was poor, and communication was extremely difficult because they could not properly understand Hindi, Marathi, or even clear English. One therapist was constantly guiding the other during the session, making us feel more like practice subjects than paying customers.

Since time had already been wasted, the therapists then rushed through the remaining massage just to complete the session. Even the shower experience afterward was terrible. The shower system had multiple nozzles and unstable temperature control, making it genuinely unsafe — if you are not quick enough, the water suddenly becomes extremely hot.

When we politely informed the receptionist about our dissatisfaction, instead of accountability or any attempt to resolve the issue, we were told that the therapists complained they “couldn’t give a good massage because the beds were high.” That explanation was honestly unbelievable and highly unprofessional.

No compensation, no concern, and no effort to improve the experience — just a casual “sorry ma’am and sir.”

The only positive takeaway from this experience is that we are glad we did not purchase the membership.

Today I called to book an appointment for 8:15 PM. The receptionist took my number and said she would call back to confirm. I waited for almost 30 minutes but received no callback. When I called again around 6 PM, instead of confirming properly, she casually said, “Aap abhi aa jao.” When I explained that I was specifically asking for an appointment timing, she became rude and started giving unnecessary excuses like, “Main yaha akeli hu, manager nahi hai.”

As a customer, it is not my responsibility to manage your staff shortage or business operations. People visit a spa for relaxation and professional service, not to deal with frustrated and unprofessional behaviour at the reception desk.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely poor hospitality and unprofessional behavior.

I have been a regular customer of this branch, however the quality of service has declined drastically.

I recently delivered twins and am on a very tight schedule. Despite booking an appointment at 2 pm on my previous visit, my spa did not start until 2.35 pm. They made me wait without any concern for my time. I had to leave urgently to be back before my babies woke up. On top of that, the therapist was not up to the mark.

Even after this experience, I still decided to give them another chance as I have pending hours with them.

Today I booked an appointment for 11 am. At 10.15 am, I realized I would be slightly late and proactively called the branch to inform them that I would reach by 11.30 am. The staff member said she could not make the therapist wait, so I immediately confirmed that I would reach by 11.15 am instead. I also confirmed the same on WhatsApp.

Despite this, my appointment was given to someone else and I was told to come at 12 pm.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Escapeverse and chose the "Murder on Eclipse Express" room. Based on the marketing and hype around their use of advanced technology and sensors, I had high expectations. Unfortunately, the experience did not justify the price we paid.

While the room does use a few sensors and automated mechanisms to unlock doors, the technology itself is quite limited and does not significantly enhance the gameplay. The "latest technology" claim feels exaggerated compared to what is actually offered inside the room.

The biggest disappointment was the storyline. As a murder mystery-themed escape room, I expected a logical and engaging investigation. Instead, many of the conclusions required players to make unrealistic assumptions, and the story progression often felt disconnected from the clues provided. Rather than rewarding logical thinking, several puzzles seemed to rely on guesswork. A good escape room should make players feel like detectives solving a mystery, but that feeling was largely missing here.

The room theme was "Murder on Eclipse Express," yet there was very little that made us feel like we were actually on a train. The ambience, setup, and overall immersion did not effectively support the theme. The train environment felt underdeveloped, which made it harder to connect with the story.

Another point worth mentioning is the room size. The space is quite limited and is best suited for 2–3 participants. Larger groups may find it cramped, with some members having little to do during certain parts of the game.

The overall condition of the premises was also disappointing. If you visit, I would recommend using the lift instead of the stairs, as the staircase were dirty and lighting was not there during our visit. Additionally, there were ants outside the room entrance, and some even got into my shoes, causing discomfort after leaving from venue. Basic cleanliness and hygiene around the venue should be maintained more carefully though inside cleanliness was good.

Finally, I was surprised by the handling of the payment receipt. After making payment, I requested a receipt but was initially told it could not be provided. It was only shared the following day via WhatsApp. A receipt should ideally be issued immediately upon payment.

Overall, I found Escapeverse to be significantly overhyped. The technology, storyline, immersion, venue maintenance, and customer service did not meet expectations for the amount charged. There is definitely room for improvement, particularly in creating a more logical story, enhancing the thematic experience, maintaining better hygiene, and providing a smoother customer experience.
